To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we propose flatness-aware regularizers for generalizable learning to optimize.

($i$) we introduce flatness-aware regularizers into L1O for shaping the loss surface's local geometry; ($ii$), the flatness-aware regularizer guides the optimizee to locate minimas in large, flat regions of loss landscape; ($iii$), the flat region's existence ensures the generalization of the optimizee, and the regularizer's effectiveness has been theoretically proved; ($iv$), extensive experiments validate our proposal's effectiveness on various L2O models
we propose a novel L2O approach to optimize into wide valleys, which can significantly improve the optimizee generalization ability of L2O, and the optimizer generalization as well.

the generalization of learning to optimize, and the results are expected to be of great value for both theory and practice.
